text:
priya: Running into TLS verify failures in the Python SDK when our Dedicated endpoint sits behind a corp proxy that terminates TLS with our internal CA. Only happens on retries.

ben: sync or async client? quick repro?

priya: both. minimal: 
```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client(base_url='https://dedicated.us.redwood', api_key='***', proxy='http://proxy.corp:3128', ca_bundle='/etc/ssl/corp-ca.pem')
c.chat.create(model='rw-v1', input='ping')
```
first request OK, retry path fails with `ClientConnectorCertificateError: unable to get local issuer certificate`.

omar: likely we rebuild session/connector on retry and forget to attach the SSLContext/ca file. requests honors REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE but aiohttp needs explicit SSLContext.

ciara: confirm: in Retry middleware we close and recreate sessions. For async we do `aiohttp.ClientSession()` without passing the connector; for sync we call `requests.Session()` but don't always set `session.verify` on the new session.

priya: proposed fixes: (1) add explicit `ca_bundle` (str) and `ssl_context` (advanced) args to Client ctor, pass through to both sync/async; (2) when recreating sessions, reapply ssl params or reuse the existing session/connector; (3) document env-var workarounds. I prefer (1)+(2).

ben: +1. UX: `ca_bundle` is easiest for customers; `ssl_context` for platform teams who build contexts. Validate they don't conflict.

omar: impl notes: for sync set `session.verify = ca_bundle` or use `requests.adapters.HTTPAdapter` with proper SSLContext; for async do `ctx = ssl.create_default_context()` then `ctx.load_verify_locations(cafile=ca_bundle)` and pass to `aiohttp.TCPConnector(ssl=ctx)` used by ClientSession. Ensure retry path reuses connector or reconstructs it with same ctx.

ciara: add a regression test: local proxy that presents corp CA, return 502 then 200 to force retry. Assert client succeeds when using `ca_bundle`. Keep timeouts low and control backoff to avoid flakes.

ops-bot: telemetry: 5 occurrences in the last 72h tagged proxy-tls-corpca on Dedicated eu-1. No open PR.

priya: workaround for customers: mount CA to `/etc/ssl/corp-ca.pem` and pass `Client(ca_bundle='/etc/ssl/corp-ca.pem')`. Also `REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE` helps for sync only.

ben: i'll own the API change. add `ca_bundle: Optional[str] = None, ssl_context: Optional[ssl.SSLContext] = None` to constructor and wire through. Add validation and precedence docs.

omar: i'll add the connector/session fixes and the integration test. ciara, can you write the docs snippet for Dedicated/Private onboarding?

ciara: yup. will include sample-app change and a short migration note.

priya: opened draft PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/531 (WIP) with initial wiring and test scaffold. assigning @ben @omar for review.

ben: LGTM at a glance. naming nit: `ca_bundle` is clear. keep param docs explicit about file path vs in-memory contexts.

priya: thanks all. I'll update PR with fixes from review and follow up when CI passes.
